'''First Anthology''' is the ninth expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 1 June 1997. The set consists of 6 new promotional cards.

Each '''First Anthology''' set also contains two white border [[Premiere Unlimited '95|Premiere]] 60-card starter decks, two 15-card booster packs of white border cards [[Premiere Unlimited '95|Premiere]], two 15-card booster packs each of [[Alternate Universe]] and [[Q-Continuum]], and one [[Warp Pack]]. Also included is a special numbered doorway "Door to the Fajo Collection" coupon to be used to obtain a rebate after the purchase of '''[[The Fajo Collection]]''' and a 12 page Rules Supplement booklet.

The set is noted for the following:
* The first appearance of the Deep Space Nine property logo
* The first appearance of the Voyager property logo
* All cards would be 'found' in later expansion sets
* First appearance of the "The Motion Pictures' staffing icon (Ensign Tuvok)
* First appearance of a Ferengi affiliation personnel card
* First appearance of a Cardassian affiliation personnel card
